name: Kujou Ageha
source:
A happy-go-lucky young girl who easily attracts people. She quickly became [url=/c14599]Yumemi’s[/url] friend and the poster girl for Café Anzu.

Currently her parents are away from home, so she lives alone with her pets.

She seems to be all smiles and rainbows, but…

[Based on the [url=https://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/extra/cha/extra_cha_02_2_1.htm]official description[/url]]
